verdict.rationale: Vapi's own docs describe Evals, which use mock conversations to validate agents before production, and a CLI that can switch between organizations and environments. Together these suggest pre-production testing and some environment separation. However, nothing explicitly documents a sandbox environment whose data is isolated from production. Mock-conversation testing is closer to simulation than to sandbox isolation, and tools may still call real webhooks. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented sandbox/test environment, a guarantee that test runs do not touch production data or live integrations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Switch between organizations and environments seamlessly
you'll create mock conversations, define expected behaviors, and validate your agents work correctly before production
Voice Test Suites enable you to test your AI voice agents through simulated phone conversations.
